title: on_behalf_of_user resources are excluded from UC model-version dependencies
answers: on behalf of user resource recorded as model dependency
why is my invoker resource missing from the registered model version dependencies
UC model version dependencies for user-authorized resources
body:
Invariant: resources declared with on_behalf_of_user set are not recorded as model-version dependencies on CreateModelVersionRequest; this holds for every dependency type, including DATABRICKS_UC_MODEL_SERVICE.
Enforced in mlflow/store/_unity_catalog/registry/rest_store.py:_fetch_langchain_dependency_from_model_resources, which each per-type branch of get_model_version_dependencies calls.
If a new resource type is wired without going through that helper, invoker-scoped resources leak into the dependency list. Tests in tests/store/_unity_catalog/model_registry/test_unity_catalog_rest_store.py cover this with the invoker-resources fixture.
applies: Proxy/legacy path dependency extraction for langchain model resources in the UC registry store.
says: User-scoped resources should never appear in the registered model version dependency list.
Catalog model versions are mistakenly listing invoker-authorized services as required dependencies.
Prevent personal user-authorized resources from being saved as model version dependencies upon registration.
Invoker resources should not be included when registering a new catalog model version.
User-authenticated services are unexpectedly missing from the registered model dependencies tab.
search: In Unity Catalog registry store model-version dependency extraction, resources declared with on_behalf_of_user are excluded from CreateModelVersionRequest dependencies across all dependency types, including DATABRICKS_UC_MODEL_SERVICE. This rule applies to proxy/legacy path dependency extraction for LangChain model resources and is enforced by having every per-type branch of get_model_version_dependencies call _fetch_langchain_dependency_from_model_resources in mlflow/store/_unity_catalog/registry/rest_store.py. Wiring any new resource type without that helper leaks invoker-scoped resources into the dependency list, which is tested using the invoker-resources fixture in tests/store/_unity_catalog/model_registry/test_unity_catalog_rest_store.py.
